title: Lyttelton Gaol

terrainReference.basis: Original provider grade beside Oxford Street, near the former entrance side. This does not survey the vanished entrance.

mapIdentity.provider: Christchurch City Council District Plan item 738 and original OpenStreetMap paths at the former Gaol site.
mapIdentity.scope: The named former site is bounded by Christchurch City Council heritage item 425, Schedule 738, Heritage New Zealand listing 7353. Its original recorded geometry and surviving path controls anchor an estimated late-operating footprint using 1873–78 construction and yard records.

note: Original provider terrain near the Oxford Street frontage fixes model zero. The two main courts step upward into the slope. The 1878 yard dimensions, 1873 two-storey concrete range and 1875 three-storey eastward wing inform the geometry.
